title: Correcting the Logic Behind the 2026 US Vehicle Emissions Standard Rollback
The Impact of the 2022 Oil Embargo and Price Cap on Russian Oil Prices
abstract: This paper documents the effect of the oil embargo and price cap on Russian oil exports in the wake of the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. We show that the embargo forced Russia to accept a $32/bbl discount on its Urals crude in March 2023 relative to January 2022, nearly half of which is directly attributable to the higher cost of shipping crude oil over longer distances, as Russia diverted much of its crude oil exports to India. Based on a calibrated model of global oil supply and demand, the remainder ($17/bbl) can be explained by increased Indian bargaining power. We also provide a similar analysis for the ESPO price discount on exports to China. In contrast, the price cap deprived Russia of the financial resources it spent on assembling a “shadow” fleet of tankers, but its effect on the Russian oil export price was negligible once the adoption of the price cap had facilitated the use of Western services to transport Russian oil to Asia.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，石油禁运和价格上限对俄罗斯石油出口的影响。我们发现，相较于2022年1月，禁运迫使俄罗斯在2023年3月将其乌拉尔原油的折扣提高至每桶32美元，其中近一半可直接归因于原油因运往更远目的地而增加的运输成本，因为俄罗斯将大量原油出口转向了印度。基于全球石油供需的校准模型，其余部分（每桶17美元）可由印度议价能力的提升来解释。我们还对出口中国的ESPO原油价格折扣进行了类似分析。相比之下，价格上限使俄罗斯失去了用于组建“影子”油轮船队的财务资源，但在价格上限的实施促使西方服务企业得以将俄罗斯石油运往亚洲之后，其对俄罗斯石油出口价格的影响微乎其微。

title: Do Bill Shocks Induce Energy Efficiency Investments?
abstract: Inattention can lead to suboptimal investment in energy efficiency. We study whether electricity bill shocks draw attention to the benefits of home energy efficiency investments. Our novel identification strategy builds on the fact that prolonged extreme weather events (which raise electricity costs for many customers) fall within a single billing cycle for some customers but are split across cycles for others. We find that households exposed to average sized bill shocks are 22 percent more likely to invest in energy efficiency than households with normal bills. This result suggests that inattention is indeed a factor in residential energy decisions and utilities may be able to leverage bill shocks to promote efficiency investments.
abstract_zh: 注意力不足可能导致能源效率投资低于最优水平。我们研究电费冲击是否能够让人们关注家庭能源效率投资的收益。我们提出的新识别策略基于以下事实：长时间的极端天气事件（会提高许多用户的电费）对部分用户而言落在同一个账单周期内，而对另一些用户则被分割到不同周期。我们发现，遭受平均规模电费冲击的家庭，比账单正常的家庭投资能源效率的可能性高出22%。这一结果表明，注意力不足确实是居民能源决策中的一个因素，公用事业公司或可借助电费冲击来推动效率投资。

title: How To Spend One Trillion Dollars: the U.S. Decarbonization Conundrum
The Electric Ceiling: Limits and Costs of Full Electrification
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, 2024
abstract: Electrification is a centerpiece of global decarbonization efforts. Yet there are reasons to be skeptical of the inevitability, or at least the optimal pace, of the transition. We discuss several under-appreciated costs of full, or even deep, electrification. Consumer preferences can operate in favor of and in opposition to electrification goals; and electrification is likely to encounter physical and economic obstacles when it reaches some as-yet-unknown level. While we readily acknowledge the external benefits of decarbonization, we also explore several under-appreciated external costs. The credibility and eventual success of decarbonization efforts is enhanced by foreseeing and ideally avoiding predictable but non-obvious costs of promising abatement pathways. Thus, even with all of its promise, the degree of electrification may ultimately reach a limit.
abstract_zh: 电气化是全球脱碳努力的核心。然而，有理由对这一转型的必然性，或至少其最优速度，持怀疑态度。我们讨论了完全乃至深度电气化的若干未被充分认识的成本。消费者偏好既可能有利于电气化目标，也可能与之相悖；而且，当电气化达到某个尚不确定的水平时，很可能遭遇物理和经济上的障碍。尽管我们承认脱碳的外部效益，但也探讨了若干未被充分认识的外部成本。脱碳努力的可信度和最终成功，取决于能否预见并尽可能避免有前景的减排路径中可预见但不明显的成本。因此，即便电气化前景广阔，其程度最终也可能触及上限。

title: The End of Neutrality? LCFS, Technology Neutrality, and the EV Market
Global Transportation Decarbonization
abstract: A number of policy proposals call for replacing fossil fuels in the name of decarbonization, but these fuels will be difficult to replace due to to their as-yet unrivaled bundle of attributes: abundance, ubiquity, energy density, transportability and cost. There is a growing commitment to electrification as the dominant decarbonization pathway for transportation. While deep electrification is promising for road vehicles in wealthy countries, it will face steep obstacles. In other sectors and in the developing world, it’s not even in pole position. Global transportation decarbonization will require decoupling emissions from economic growth, and decoupling emissions from growth will require not only new technologies, but cooperation in governance. The menu of policy options is replete with tradeoffs, particularly as the primacy of energy security and reliability (over emissions abatement) has once again been demonstrated in Europe and elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 许多政策建议主张以脱碳之名替代化石燃料，但由于化石燃料具备无可匹敌的综合特性——储量丰富、分布广泛、能量密度高、便于运输且成本低廉——它们将难以被替代。越来越多的人承诺以电气化作为交通领域脱碳的主要路径。尽管深度电气化在富裕国家的道路车辆上前景可观，但将面临严峻障碍。在其他部门以及发展中世界，电气化甚至尚未处于首选地位。全球交通脱碳需要使排放与经济增长脱钩，而要实现这种脱钩，不仅需要新技术，还需要治理上的合作。政策选项的菜单充满权衡取舍，尤其是在欧洲及其他地区，能源安全与可靠性（优先于减排）的首要地位再次得到了体现。

title: The Economics of Electric Vehicles
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, 2023
abstract: We examine the private and public economics of electric vehicles (EVs) and discuss when market forces will produce the optimal path of EV adoption. Privately, consumer cost savings from EVs vary. Some experience net benefits from choosing gasoline cars, even after accounting for EV subsidies. Publicly, we survey the literature documenting the external costs and benefits of EVs and highlight several themes for optimal policy design including, 1) promoting regional variation in EV policies that align private incentives with social benefits, 2) pursuing a time-path of policies that reflect changing marginal benefits, and 3) rationalizing electricity and gasoline prices to reflect their social marginal cost. On the extensive margin, purchase incentives should ramp-down as learning-by-doing and network externalities (to the extent that they exist) diminish; on the intensive margin, gasoline should become relatively more expensive over time than electricity (per mile traveled) to reflect cleaner marginal emissions from electricity generation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察电动汽车（EV）的私人与公共经济学，并讨论市场力量何时能够产生最优的电动汽车普及路径。从私人角度看，电动汽车带来的消费者成本节约因人而异。即使计入电动汽车补贴，一些消费者选择燃油汽车仍能获得净收益。从公共角度看，我们梳理了记录电动汽车外部成本与收益的文献，并重点提出最优政策设计的几个要点：（1）推行区域差异化的电动汽车政策，使私人激励与社会效益相一致；（2）实施随边际收益变化而调整的时间路径政策；（3）调整电价和油价，使其反映社会边际成本。在扩展边际（即是否购买）上，随着边做边学效应和网络外部性（若确实存在）的减弱，购置补贴应逐步退坡；在集约边际（即使用强度）上，随着时间推移，每英里行驶的油价相对于电价应逐步提高，以反映电力发电更为清洁的边际排放。

title: Correcting Estimates of Electric Vehicle Emissions Abatement
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 2022
abstract: Transportation electrification is viewed by many as a cornerstone for climate change mitigation, with the ultimate vision to phase out conventional vehicles entirely. In a world with only electric vehicles (EVs), transportation pollution would be primarily determined by the electricity grid composition. For the foreseeable future, however, environmental benefits of EVs must be measured relative to the (likely gasoline) car that would have been bought instead. This so-called “counterfactual” vehicle cannot be observed, but its fuel economy can be estimated. A quasi-experiment in California allows us to show that subsidized buyers of EVs would have, on average, purchased relatively fuel-efficient cars had they not gone electric. The actual incremental pollution abatement arising from EVs today is thus substantially smaller than one would predict using the fleet average as the counterfactual vehicle. We discuss implications for climate policy and how to accurately reflect EV choice in integrated assessment models.
abstract_zh: 许多人将交通电气化视为应对气候变化的基石，其最终愿景是完全淘汰传统汽车。在只有电动汽车的世界里，交通污染将主要由电网构成决定。然而，在可预见的未来，电动汽车的环境效益必须相对于本应购买的（很可能是汽油）汽车来衡量。这一所谓的“反事实”车辆无法被直接观测，但其燃油经济性可以估计。我们利用加州的一项准实验表明，获得补贴的电动汽车购买者，若未选择电动汽车，平均而言会购买燃油经济性相对较高的汽车。因此，当今电动汽车实际带来的增量污染减排，远小于以车队平均水平作为反事实车辆所预测的结果。我们讨论了这一发现对气候政策的含义，以及如何在综合评估模型中准确反映电动汽车的选择。

title: Subsidizing Low- and Middle-Income Adoption of Electric Vehicles
abstract: Little is known about electric vehicle (EV) demand by low-and middle-income households. In this paper, we exploit a policy that provides exogenous variation in large EV subsidies targeted at the mass market in California. Using transaction-level data, we estimate three important policy parameters: the rate of subsidy pass-through, the impact of the subsidy on EV adoption, and the elasticity of demand for EVs among low-and middle-income households. Demand for EVs in our sample is price-elastic (-3.3) and pass-through to buyers is indistinguishable from 100 percent. We use these estimates to calculate that the expected subsidy bill required for California to reach its goal of 1.5 million EVs by 2025 is likely to exceed $12-18 billion.
abstract_zh: 人们对中低收入家庭的电动汽车（EV）需求知之甚少。本文利用加州一项针对大众市场、提供大额电动汽车补贴的政策所带来的外生变异，基于交易层面的数据，估计了三个重要的政策参数：补贴传导率、补贴对电动汽车普及的影响，以及中低收入家庭对电动汽车需求的弹性。在我们的样本中，电动汽车需求价格弹性较大（-3.3），补贴向购买者的传导率与100%无显著差异。利用这些估计值，我们测算出加州若要实现到2025年推广150万辆电动汽车的目标，所需的补贴总额很可能超过120亿至180亿美元。

title: Estimating the Elasticity to Real Time Pricing
Future Paths of Electric Vehicle Adoption in the United States
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy, 2021
abstract: This paper identifies and quantifies major determinants of future electric vehicle (EV) demand in order to inform widely-held aspirations for market growth. Our model compares three channels that will affect EV market share in the United States from 2020-2035: intrinsic (no-subsidy) EV demand growth, net-of-subsidy EV cost declines (e.g. batteries), and government subsidies. Geographic variation in preferences for sedans and light trucks highlights the importance of viable EV alternatives to conventional light trucks; belief in climate change is highly correlated with EV adoption patterns; and the first $500 billion in cumulative nationwide EV subsidies is associated a 7-10 percent increase in EV market share in 2035, an effect that diminishes as subsidies increase. The rate of intrinsic demand growth dwarfs the impact of demand-side subsidies and battery cost declines, highlighting the importance of non-monetary factors (e.g. charging infrastructure, product quality and/or cultural acceptance) on EV demand.
abstract_zh: 本文识别并量化了影响未来电动汽车（EV）需求的主要决定因素，以为广受期待的市场增长目标提供依据。我们的模型比较了将在2020至2035年间影响美国电动汽车市场份额的三种渠道：内生的（无补贴）电动汽车需求增长、扣除补贴后的电动汽车成本下降（如电池成本降低）以及政府补贴。轿车与轻卡偏好的地理差异凸显了可行的电动汽车替代品对于取代传统轻卡的重要性；对气候变化的信念与电动汽车的普及格局高度相关；全国累计前5000亿美元的电动汽车补贴，与2035年电动汽车市场份额提高7%至10%相关，且该效应随补贴增加而递减。内生需求增长的速度远超需求侧补贴和电池成本下降的影响，这凸显了非货币因素（如充电基础设施、产品质量和/或文化接受度）对电动汽车需求的重要性。

title: Low Energy: Estimating Electric Vehicle Electricity Use
abstract: We provide the first at-scale estimate of electric vehicle (EV) home charging. Previous estimates are based on conflicting surveys or are extrapolated from a small, unrepresentative sample of households with dedicated EV meters. We combine billions of hourly electricity meter measurements with address-level EV registration records from California households, including 64,000 EV owners. The average EV increases overall household load by 2.9 kilowatt-hours per day, well under half the amount assumed by state regulators. Results imply that EVs travel less than expected on electric power, raising questions about transportation electrification for climate policy.
abstract_zh: 我们首次给出了电动汽车（EV）家庭充电的大规模估计。以往的估计要么基于相互矛盾的调查，要么是从一小批配备专用电表、缺乏代表性的家庭样本外推得出。我们将数十亿条每小时电表测量数据与加州家庭的地址级电动汽车注册记录相结合，涵盖64,000名电动汽车车主。平均而言，一辆电动汽车使家庭总负荷每天增加2.9千瓦时，远低于州监管机构假设数值的一半。研究结果表明，电动汽车使用电力的行驶里程低于预期，这对以交通电气化推进气候政策的合理性提出了疑问。

title: Attribute Substitution in Household Vehicle Portfolios
Machine Learning from Schools about Energy Efficiency
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 2020
abstract: We use high-frequency panel data on electricity consumption to study the effectiveness of energy efficiency upgrades in K–12 schools in California. Using a panel fixed effects approach, we find that these upgrades deliver between 12% and 86% of expected savings, depending on specification and treatment of outliers. Using machine learning to inform our specification choice, we estimate a narrower range: 52%–98%, with a central estimate of 60%. These results imply that upgrades are performing less well than ex ante predictions on average, although we can reject some of the very low realization rates found in prior work.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频面板电力消费数据，研究加州K–12年级学校节能改造的成效。采用面板固定效应方法，我们发现这些改造所带来的节能量为预期节约量的12%至86%，具体取决于模型设定以及对异常值的处理方式。借助机器学习来辅助确定模型设定，我们将估计范围缩小至52%–98%，中心估计值为60%。这些结果表明，改造的实际效果平均而言低于事前预测，不过我们可以排除先前研究中发现的一些极低的实现率。

title: Utilities Included: Split Incentives in Commercial Electricity Contracts
abstract: This paper quantifies a tenant-side “split incentives” problem that exists when the largest commercial sector customers are on electricity-included property lease contracts, causing them to face a marginal electricity price of zero. We use exogenous variation in weather shocks to show that the largest firms on tenant-paid contracts use up to 14 percent less electricity in response to summer temperature fluctuations. The result is retrieved under weaker identifying assumptions than previous split incentives papers, and is robust when exposed to several opportunities to fail. The electricity reduction in response to temperature increases is likely to be a lower bound when generalized nationwide and suggests that policymakers should consider a sub-metering policy to expose the largest commercial tenants to the prevailing retail electricity price.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了一个租户方的“激励分离”问题，该问题存在于最大的商业部门客户签订包含电费在内的物业租赁合同时，使其面临的边际电价为零。我们利用天气冲击的外生变异表明，签订租户自付电费合同的最大企业，在夏季气温波动时用电量最多减少14%。该结果是在比以往激励分离研究更弱的识别假设下得出的，并且在多次可能被推翻的稳健性检验中保持稳健。若推广至全国，气温升高所引起的用电减少很可能是下限，这表明政策制定者应考虑实施分表计量政策，使最大的商业租户面对现行零售电价。

title: Does Absolution Promote Sin? A Conservationist's Dilemma
Flawed Analysis of U.S. Auto Fuel Economy Standards
Regression Discontinuity in Time: Considerations for Empirical Applications
The Rebound Effect and Energy Efficiency Policy
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, 2016
abstract: What do we know about the size of the rebound effect, the well-known phenomenon that improving energy efficiency may save less energy than expected due to a rebound of energy use? Is there any validity to the claims that energy efficiency improvements can actually lead to an increase in energy use (known as backfire)? This article clarifies what the rebound effect is and provides a guide for economists and policymakers interested in its existence and magnitude. We discuss how some studies in the literature consider a rebound effect that results from a costless exogenous increase in energy efficiency, whereas others examine the effects of a specific energy efficiency policy—a distinction that leads to very different welfare and policy implications. We present the most reliable evidence available about the size of the energy efficiency rebound effect and discuss situations where such estimation is extraordinarily difficult. With this in mind, we present a new way of thinking about the macroeconomic rebound effect. We conclude that overall, the existing research provides little support for the so-called backfire hypothesis. However, our understanding of the macroeconomic rebound effect remains limited, particularly as it relates to induced innovation and productivity growth. (JEL: H23, Q38, Q41)
abstract_zh: 关于反弹效应（即提高能源效率所节约的能源可能少于预期，原因在于能源使用量的反弹），我们究竟了解多少？其规模有多大？能源效率改进是否真的可能导致能源使用量增加（即所谓的“逆反”或backfire）？本文阐明了反弹效应的含义，并为关注其存在性和规模的经济学家与政策制定者提供指导。我们讨论了文献中的一些研究考察的是成本为零的外生能源效率提升所引起的反弹效应，而另一些研究考察的则是具体能效政策的效果——这一区别会导致截然不同的福利和政策含义。我们呈现了关于能效反弹效应规模的现有最可靠证据，并讨论了此类估计极为困难的情形。在此基础上，我们提出了一种思考宏观反弹效应的新方式。我们的结论是，总体而言，现有研究几乎不支持所谓的“逆反假说”。然而，我们对宏观反弹效应的理解仍然有限，特别是在其与诱致性创新和生产率增长的关系方面。（JEL: H23, Q38, Q41）

title: Utilization and Customer Behavior: Smart Choices for the Smart Grid
venue: Smart Grid Handbook, John Wiley & Sons, 2016

title: Commercial and Industrial Demand Response Under Mandatory Time-of-Use Electricity Pricing
From Cradle to Junkyard: Assessing the Life Cycle Greenhouse Gas Benefits of Electric Vehicles
Durable Goods and Long-Run Electricity Demand: Evidence from Air Conditioner Purchase Behavior
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 2014

title: Knowledge is (Less) Power: Experimental Evidence from Residential Energy Use
abstract: Imperfect information about product attributes inhibits efficiency in many choice settings, but can be overcome by providing simple, low-cost information. We use a randomized control trial to test the effect of high-frequency information about residential electricity usage on the price elasticity of demand. Informed households are three standard deviations more responsive to temporary price increases, an effect that is not attributable to price salience. Conservation extends beyond pricing events in the short and medium run, providing evidence of habit formation and implying that the intervention leads to greenhouse gas abatement. Survey evidence suggests that information facilitates learning. (JEL D12, D83, L11, L94, Q41, Q54)
abstract_zh: 关于产品属性的信息不完全，会在许多选择场景中抑制效率，但通过提供简单、低成本的信息可以克服这一问题。我们利用随机对照试验，检验关于居民用电的高频信息对需求价格弹性的影响。获得信息的家庭对临时性价格上涨的反应强烈三个标准差，且这一效应并非源于价格显著性。节约行为在短期和中期内延续至定价事件之外，显示出习惯形成的证据，并表明该干预会带来温室气体减排。调查证据表明，信息有助于学习。（JEL D12, D83, L11, L94, Q41, Q54）

title: Towards Understanding the Role of Price in Residential Energy Choices: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization, 2014

title: Internet and the Efficiency of Decentralized Markets: Evidence from Automobiles
The Rebound Effect is Overplayed
Split Incentives in Residential Energy Consumption
abstract: We explore two split incentive issues between owners and occupants of residential dwellings: heating or cooling incentives are suboptimal when the occupant does not pay for energy use, and insulation incentives are suboptimal when the occupant cannot perfectly observe the owner’s insulation choice. We empirically quantify the effect of these two market failures and how they affect behavior in California. We find that those who pay are 16 percent more likely to change the heating setting at night and owner-occupied dwellings are 20 percent more likely to be insulated in the attic or ceiling. However, in contrast to common conception, we find that only small overall energy savings may be possible from policy interventions aimed at correcting the split incentive issues.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了住宅业主与居住者之间的两种激励分离问题：当居住者不为能源使用付费时，供暖或制冷的激励并非最优；当居住者无法完全观察到业主的保温决策时，保温激励也非最优。我们实证量化了这两种市场失灵的效应，以及它们如何影响加州的居民行为。我们发现，付费的居住者在夜间调整供暖设定的可能性高出16%，而自住住宅的阁楼或天花板保温的可能性高出20%。然而，与普遍看法相反，我们发现，旨在纠正激励分离问题的政策干预，其带来的总体能源节约可能很小。

title: Would the Fair Tax raise or lower marginal and average tax rates?
venue: Fundamental Tax Reform: Issues, Choices, and Implications, MIT Press, 2008

title: Does it pay, at the margin, to work and save? Measuring the effective marginal taxes on Americans’ labor supply and savings
Energy Prices and Electric Vehicle Adoption
abstract: This paper presents evidence that gasoline prices have a larger effect on demand for electric vehicles (EVs) than electricity prices in California. We match a spatially-disaggregated panel dataset of monthly EV registration records to detailed records of gasoline and electricity prices in California from 2014-2017, and use these to estimate the effect of energy prices on EV demand. Two distinct empirical approaches (panel fixed-effects and a utility-border discontinuity) yield remarkably similar results: a given change in gasoline prices has roughly four to six times the effect on EV demand as a similar percentage change in electricity prices. We explore the implications for optimal EV subsidies, which promote externality reduction benefits and correct for consumer misoptimization stemming from the undervaluation of future electricity costs.
abstract_zh: 本文提供证据表明，在加州，汽油价格对电动汽车（EV）需求的影响大于电价。我们将2014至2017年加州按月的电动汽车注册记录（空间细分的面板数据）与详细的汽油和电价记录相匹配，并据此估计能源价格对电动汽车需求的影响。两种不同的实证方法（面板固定效应和电力公司服务区边界断点设计）得出了极为相似的结果：汽油价格的给定变动对电动汽车需求的影响，约为同等百分比电价变动影响的四至六倍。我们探讨了这一结果对最优电动汽车补贴的含义，此类补贴既能促进外部性减少带来的收益，也能纠正因低估未来电费成本而导致的消费者决策偏误。

title: Smooth Operator? Managing Electric Vehicle Integration in Constrained Distribution Networks
abstract:
Electricity distribution network constraints may ultimately limit the pace of transportation electrification. This paper examines the underappreciated challenges that electric vehicle (EV) adoption poses for the distribution grid. While prior research has focused on bulk power and private service upgrades, we emphasize how local distribution capacity is strained by reduced load diversity at small aggregations. We highlight two alternatives to costly infrastructure expansion: (1) demand-based tariffs that allocate scarce distribution capacity more efficiently, and (2) managed charging programs that coordinate EV loads within local limits. While managed charging reduces transformer overloads and smooths load profiles, consumer participation remains a barrier. Economists can play a key role by designing rate structures that align user incentives with local network constraints and by evaluating consumer acceptance of these solutions as electrification advances.
JEL Classification:
Q40, Energy: General; Q50, Environmental Economics: General
abstract_zh:
配电网约束最终可能限制交通电气化的速度。本文考察了电动汽车（EV）普及给配电网带来的、未被充分认识的挑战。以往研究主要关注大容量电力和私人服务升级，而我们强调，在小规模负荷聚合下，由于负荷多样性降低，本地配电容量会承受压力。我们提出了两种替代昂贵基础设施扩建的方案：（1）需量电价，以更有效地分配稀缺的配电容量；（2）有管理的充电项目，在本地限值内协调电动汽车负荷。虽然有管理的充电能够减少变压器过载并平滑负荷曲线，但用户参与仍是一大障碍。随着电气化的推进，经济学家可以通过设计使用户激励与本地电网约束相一致的电价结构，并评估用户对这些解决方案的接受程度，从而发挥关键作用。
